title: Quality Director
text:
**Lead Quality Strategy & Division Performance**
Own and advance the division’s quality strategy across the full product lifecycle—product safety, laboratory operations, manufacturing processes, customer support, and compliance. This role ensures quality is built into how products are developed, produced, tested, supported, and governed, with clear standards that protect both customers and the business.
 
 
Direct a high-performing technical and quality team by setting expectations, coaching talent, and strengthening technical capability. Drive continuous improvement by analyzing trends, preventing repeat issues, and improving product performance and operational effectiveness.
 
 
Collaborate across functions to resolve customer quality concerns, manage investigations, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Lead efforts to strengthen supplier performance through clear requirements, effective feedback loops, and performance monitoring.
 
 
**What You’ll Bring**

* Deep quality and compliance knowledge spanning operations, lab/testing, and customer-facing processes
* Strong problem-solving and investigation skills, with a focus on root cause and sustainable fixes
* Proven leadership capability to develop teams and improve technical performance
* Experience partnering with suppliers and enforcing quality expectations
* Comfort managing risk and driving measurable improvement in product and operational outcomes
